features: HR process and inventory Excel exports with retained CSV

release_validation.base: GitHub main matches the UI150 local Git tree and runtime manifest
release_validation.assembly: A copy of the verified deployed parent and the bundled vendor-to-UI150 chain independently apply the UI151 overlay. Every member is verified and the resulting manifests and SHA-256 values match.
release_validation.help: Both app languages, current full reference and search catalogue, exact routed content, PDFs with retained originals and new appendix navigation, and the ten landing shortcuts.
release_validation.camera: Synthetic real-browser camera, permission denial, retake, cancellation, local file fallback, own-profile authorization, and explicit attachment/profile saves. No physical camera was used by automated validation.
release_validation.excel: Native workbook open with an independent Excel reader, date and numeric cells, leading-zero identifiers, literal text, selected scopes, equivalent accessible CSV rows, downloads and navigation with retained mobile controls.
release_validation.source_review: Only verified baseline resources and the reviewed feature/test additions are eligible. Temporary browser, camera and database fixtures are outside the bundle.
release_validation.publication: Local candidate. Production and physical-device validation are separate.

development_evidence.hr_excel: 24 downloads across six HR processes in English and Portuguese. A separate authenticated run compared 12 CSV/XLSX downloads and checked scopes, stale previews and the 3,000-record view limit with 3,005 additional expenses.
development_evidence.download_recheck: The batch QA browser initially timed out at the eleventh rapid consecutive download in both languages. The same production files passed all six processes with a paced browser. Fresh, unpaced sessions select expenses first, download Excel immediately, then CSV, and compare each cell in English and Portuguese.
development_evidence.inventory: Three final integration cases covered English, Portuguese and the desktop menu. An additional 27 inventory and logbook regression cases passed.
development_evidence.operational_logbooks: Ten isolated file checks exercised the standard-library workbook generator, pre-existing report semantics, value typing, localized formatting and legacy PDF content.
